blocks.notes: Cells are 32x32 on alternating solid checker cells #47ffbb/#34bc88; the sheet surround is #2a966c with a #237f5a border - treat all four as transparent. The RIGHT row is a pixel-exact horizontal mirror of the LEFT row in every column except the flight cells. Row lengths: down 66 cells (0-65), left/right 58 (0-57), up 54 (0-53) with up col 1 empty (no back-view blink) and up cols 54-64 empty; up col 65 is the separate gokuSickBed block. Order: 0 idle, 1 blink, 2-5 walk, 6-9 run, 10-13 / 14-17 / 18-21 the three melee strings (wind-up, hit, follow-through, recover; the third string is the kick, so punch3 and kick share 18-21), 22-27 Instant-Transmission style teleport (22 lean back, 23 sliced dematerialise frame, 24-26 re-forming with Goku-coloured fragments, 27 settles into the fighting stance), 28-30 one-hand ki blast (28 wind-up, 29/30 alternate thrusting hands - loop 29-30 for rapid fire), 31-33 Kamehameha (31 cupped hands at the hip, 32-33 two-palm thrust that flickers while the beam is held), 34-37 overhead gather-and-throw (34 arms raised overhead, 35 brought down to the chest/forehead, 36-37 are pixel-identical to 32-33), 38 hurt recoil with a white hit spark at the head, 39-40 crossed-arm X-block (39 carries a block spark, 40 is the held pose), 41 fists-clenched power-up stance (engine aura goes on top), 42-45 arms up/down level-up cheer (42-43 with sparkles, 44-45 without; 45 is near-idle), 46-49 swimming (head and arms above the waterline, hair drifting, no baked shadow), 50-53 flying (no baked shadow), 54-57 knocked out (54 gut-hit stagger, 55 thrown back arms up / sitting, 56 landing, 57 flat), 58 sitting cross-legged asleep (head bowed, eyes shut), 59 sitting cross-legged awake, 60-63 Super Saiyan transformation (60 flex, 61 hair rising brown, 62-63 golden hair - continue on goku_super_saiyan.png), 64-65 dead with halo (hair fluttering). FLIGHT IS DIAGONAL: row 0 = flying down-right toward the camera, row 1 = down-left, row 2 = up-left (back view), row 3 = up-right (back view); row 0 is the mirror of row 1 and row 3 the mirror of row 2. So 'fly' omits right: mirror the left frames for a right-facing flight (that is exactly row 0). The row-2 frames are kept as 'flyUpLeft'. The black baked ground shadow under the feet uses #000000 - the same colour as hair and outlines - so remove it by geometry (the black run under the boots in the bottom rows), never by colour. Cells with no baked shadow: 23 (dematerialised), 46-53 (swim, fly) on every row and down-row 61-65 (transform glow, halo). Right-row cells 54-57 have a few #237f5a surround pixels on their bottom pixel row (y=31): they are ripper residue, treat as transparent. Baked effects: white swoosh trails in 11-21, hit/block/level-up sparkles (#ffffff) in 38-39 and 42-43, teleport fragments 23-26, beam glow (#424242) in 33/37, SSJ golden hair colours in 62-63, halo yellows in 64-65. Palette: paletteShared (extra key) lists colours used by more than one part - #000000 is hair, every outline and the baked shadow, so base hair can only be recoloured by region; boots share the outfit2 blue ramp and their straps use the gi ramp.

blocks.name: Goku lying sick in bed (heart virus) - head and shoulders on the pillow
blocks.notes: Single front-facing cell at up-row column 65 of the main grid (x 2080, y 128), labelled 'On bed when he's sick' on the sheet. Only the head, shoulders and collar are drawn; the eyes are shut (drawn in skin shades, so there is no eye palette) and the skin uses a paler, sickly yellow ramp than the fighter block. It is meant to be layered over a bed tile, the blanket covering the body; 'idle' and 'sick' are the same still so the block can stand alone as a cast look (it has no walk). No baked shadow, so the animation sets shadow 'keep' (the shadow finder would otherwise eat the hair edge at the bottom of the cell).
